description:
`GateRunStatus::Skipped` is never produced by a gate run. It exists only as a filter value and in the published wire vocabulary.

## Background

`GateRunStatus::Skipped` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1111`) is constructed only by the hand-written `--status` filter parser (`main.rs:1447`, message at `:1451`). It appears on these surfaces:

- CLI help at `cli.rs:1734,1780`, which flows into the published CLI schema flag description and the `GateRunStatus` enum in the `status-all` output schema (JsonSchema derive).
- The hand-written status list at `storage/reference.rs:215`, from which `docs/reference/storage-records.md:130` is generated (`scripts/generate-storage-records-reference.sh`).
- `docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1997`.
- The web `GateRunSummary.status` union (`web/src/types/models.ts:29`). `IssueDetail.tsx:552` renders unknown statuses as `·` and has no `skipped` branch.

MCP tools read the schema at runtime (`mcp-server/lib/schema-loader.js`) and hold no copy.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateRunStatus` has no `Skipped` variant, and `gate status --status skipped` is rejected as invalid input.
- [hard] REQ-02: CLI help, the output schema, the storage-records reference and its generator, and the CLI reference name no `skipped` gate-run status.
- [hard] REQ-03: The web `GateRunSummary.status` union holds no `skipped` member.

## Notes

The variant and every wire consumer change together, because the schema derives from the type.
title: Remove the skipped gate-run status
